# Flamingo Noir

Flamingo Noir combines a monospaced aesthetic with monochrome hot-pink accents on near-black and an art-directed warm-paper light mode. Pill-shaped tabs and buttons, rounded surfaces and an accent glow on active elements are listed alongside themed syntax highlighting, a styled graph view and a Source Code Pro monospace font stack with fallbacks.

![Flamingo Noir screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jackmort/flamingo-noir/HEAD/screenshot.png)
